document: Make parking on pavements a criminal offence, and fund preventative measures, The Government should make parking on pavements a criminal offence, and also provide funding to local authorities to install physical barriers between roads and pavements to make this impossible.

Ban Blanket No Pet Clauses in Tenancy Agreements & Leases, We ask the government to introduce formal legalisation that takes a fair & balanced approach to pets. We call for an end to blanket no pet clauses in tenancy agreements, protecting existing human companion animal relationships & reflecting our pet loving nation. Every pet deserves a loving home.

Stop private parking  organisations and companies stealing from the public, Put a stop to busineses that are private car parking enforcement and to stop the theft of public peoples monies and the unfair harassment to people and citizens

Allow use of Red Diesel for Charity Tractor runs, As of 1st April 2022 the government have banned the use of Red Diesel except for agricultural use. This means it can no longer be used for in Charity Tractor runs & Ploughing matches, and charities could miss out a lot of money.

Require MPs and civil servants report all contact with corporate entities, Maintain a publicly-accessible list of any contact made between (or on behalf of) corporate entities (including charities) and MPs or civil servants. MPs and civil servants should be legally required to report all such contacts, and failure to do so should be an offence.

Stop the Leicester City Council workpkace parking levy, To stop the plan by Leicester council to introduce a parking levy of £550 per parking place per year. Either employers will have to pay or pass this onto employees. This includes schools losing money that sit in the proposed boundary.

Make it mandatory for UK universities to provide parking options for students., Transportation to remote university campuses is extremely limited. Public transport is not a viable option for all students. Car parking on campus or within walking distance of campus should be made mandatory by the government.

Highlight the needs of Autistic children in main stream schools, Implement a better system in main stream schools to help Autistic children that are flying under the radar and are being unfairly treated as there classed as problem children in most cases not a child that needs help
Stop the NHS Mandate for the covid-19 Vaccine., Stop the NHS Mandate and prevent the sacking and job losses of thousands of staff in the NHS and other CQC registered services.

Improve Access To Work funding so disabled people aren't left with out support, I want the Government to improve Access To Work so disabled people who need funding get it when they need it and don't have to eat in to what little savings they may have

Make it a legal requirement for all drivers to carry their licence when driving, To amend the Road Traffic Act 1988 and make it a legal requirement for all drivers to be in possession of their licence when driving and for it to be an offence not to produce it to police officers at the time of being pulled over.

Protect the WAV disabled parking bays in Montague Place, Worthing, We need to protect the eight disabled bays in Montague Place, Worthing, to allow specially-designed vehicles to unload passengers safely into Worthing Town Centre.

Allow overnight parking to camper vans, motorhomes in no overnight parking areas, Lift restrictions to allow a limited number of parking spaces for overnight/domestic use to campervan, motorhome and vehicle dwellers in no overnight/domestic use parking locations around the UK. Increasing tourism and access for people to areas of interest.

Let international music students earn money by performing during their studies., Tier 4 International Students are legally not allowed to work as entertainers even when they are studying music as their main study. As entertaining is the reason for making a substantial move to the United Kingdom they should have to right to do paid performances to gain experience while studying.

Create an Operation Rescript medal for Armed Forces supporting Covid-19 response, The Government should create a new medal to be awarded to armed forces personnel involved in supporting civil authorities and safeguarding the public first, at personal risk, during the Covid-19 crisis.
Stop DVLA selling personal details to private companies, Make it illegal for the DVLA to sell our personal data to any private parking firm, accredited or not.

Backpay the £20 covid uplift to people on Legacy Benefits, The government paid everyone on universal credit £20 per week from April 20 to October 21 but not to the disabled on Legacy Benefits. We all struggled the same and a lot of disabled people even more than others during the pandemic so I want it paid to them backdated.

Stop falsehoods and slurs being made and repeated in the House of Commons., The leaders of our country should be an example to us and display exemplary behaviour. Where their behaviour is unlawful that is a matter for the police, when poor behaviour like falsehoods or slurs takes place in the House of Commons the Speaker should fulfil his/her role and address it.

Amend road traffic legislation to refer to 'collisions' and not 'accidents', The term ‘accident’ continues to be used in legislation and by policy makers. We would like the Government to amend the Road Traffic Act and other legislation to refer to collisions, not accidents (or incidents), and ensure that any future legislation uses this language also.

Cancel the VED rate increase (road tax) that is come into effect from April 2022, The Government or Parliament should Cancel the VED rate increase (also known as vehicle tax, car tax or road tax) that will come into effect from April 2022.

Provide Government match funding for all donations to Ukraine, At a time when the people of Ukraine are fighting for their lives we want the Government to provide funding to match donations to Ukraine many of which are not eligible for Gift Aid. Match funding should at least equal to the 25p per £1 charities get through Gift Aid.

Rescind Gavin Williamson's proposed Knighthood, given his failure/s at Education, We 'ordinary British people' have unfortunately been obliged to swallow a great deal of unsavoury / substandard political behaviour in recent years, but Williamson's havering ineptitude over our crucial Education sector was a glaring example that absolutely does not merit further reward.

Reform UK Parliament behaviour - Make “Shouting / Jeering etc” unacceptable., When we watch the Houses of Parliament debating, it is at times an embarrassing spectacle. When the speaker or chair recognises someone to speak there is often shouting, jeering, booing and general rowdy behaviour from from both Government and opposition sides. This needs to be reformed.

Have a system in place where one can view outstanding parking fines and pay them, Have a system in place or help us put a system in place where one can access all their parking fines in one place and pay them. It is not always clear which parking fines are outstanding. An example being; if you change your address there is a backlog in the system for parking alerts to be sent.

Change the marriage law in England/Wales from registered buildings to celebrants, The Scottish system of registered celebrants is much simpler and more suitable to modern-day requirements than the current English/Welsh system of registered buildings, it also offers greater flexibility to couples wanting a more personal and intimate wedding.

Make parking at work permanently free for all NHS workers, The Government should provide the funding necessary to ensure that parking at their place of work is free for all NHS workers. It is unacceptable that people who are working to save lives and care for the sick have to pay to park their car at work.
Free parking for NHS staff, Having had to work during the pandemic in unprecedented  pressures please for the loyalty to all the NHS staff make parking free In all hospitals for staff

Stop Operation Brock & find alternative solution to traffic build-up in Kent, Stop Operation Brock, in which the M20 is used to stack lorries when there is problems at Dover, and find an alternative solution to the build-up of traffic on the M20 when travel across the Channel is disrupted.

Abolish no recourse to public funds (NRPF) visa conditions, NRPF leaves people unable to access benefits and housing assistance, forcing too many into destitution and unsafe situations. The Government should end this policy in order to reduce destitution, bring dignity to those in need, and as research strongly suggests, it would save the country money.

Impose new restrictions on the placement mobile speed cameras, We want the Government to restrict the placement of mobile speed cameras so they can only be located in places that are legally parking spaces, and on flat stretches of road.

Require Ferry Companies to Comply With the Equality Act 2010, At present ferry companies have no legal obligation to make reasonable adjustment for those that are disabled and these companies may refuse boarding to disabled travellers, even if they have made their disability requirements known 48 hours in advance.

Remove the restrictions on keeping Siberian chipmunks, The Government should remove all restrictions on buying and owning Siberian chipmunks, and should leave any international agreements which constrain this. We don't believe that Chipmunks cause an environmental hazard , and that they can be a great pet with therapeutic benefits.

Advanced Nurse Practitioner (ANP/ACP) to Sign Sick note/Med3 Certificate, ANP are trained and trusted to manage a patient’s care, prescribe drugs, or admit them to hospital, but we cannot legally sign a document which allows the patient time off work for that same condition.
Hence we request Government to allow Advanced Nurse Practitioner to sign Med3 note

Get it right first time! Build west Herts A&E hospital central to its population, The Government must intervene NOW to make sure West Herts Hospital Trust include in their Outline Business Case a fully costed option to build OUR new A&E hospital in a more CENTRAL and ACCESSIBLE location. Until this has been done, the Government can’t ensure Value For Money or public support it.

Do not reduce staff-child ratios in early years childcare, The Government should not reduce the existing adult-child childcare ratios as has been suggested. There are surely better ways to reduce the cost of living – potentially endangering children in trusted care is not how it should be done.
Ban fur farming, Amend the Fur Farming (Prohibition) Act 2000 to exclude fur as a legal by-product of meat farming.

Make Residential Disabled Parking Bays Legally Enforceable., To make residential disabled parking bays legally enforceable, so people who park in these bays without a valid disabled badge can be issued penalties. It is shocking that there are no rules regarding this matter to support the wellbeing of disabled people - the council rely on human decency!?

Increase the National Living Wage to match the London Living Wage , The Government should increase the national Living Wage (currently £9.50ph) to match the optional London Living Wage (currently £11.05ph). London may be the most expensive city to live in the UK but the cost of living is increasing everywhere while wages are not!

QEHB car parking petition, Queen Elizabeth hospital Birmingham car parking charge is now 1% of staffs wages there is never any car parking spaces .why are we paying for parking  when Wales and Scotland NHS staff have parking for free .
Limit parking fines to no more than £10 per hour or similar, The government should regulate to ensure parking fines are not excessive and be based on how long over the limit was involved.

Allow trained Paramedics to prescribe controlled drugs, Change the Misuse of Drugs laows to allow Paramedics to prescribe controlled drugs if the Paramedic has completed a Non-medical Prescribing course and is a registered independent prescriber. This would mean that Paramedic Practitioners could work to the same standard as Nurse Practitioners.

Allow all registered Operating Department Practitioners to prescribe medicines, The Government should change the law to allow Operating Department Practitioners (ODPs) registered with the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC) to prescribe medication.

Require homebuilders to have insurance to cover full cost of build over £1k, The Government should require builders to take out an insurance policy to cover the build cost of any job worth over £1k, in the event they abandon the project or provide a poor service and remedial work is required. This should be used to cover the owners’ outstanding costs.

Require CCTV in supported living and care homes, To make it a legal requirement for supported living and care homes to have to install cameras in all areas. This should help prevent residents - especially vulnerable disabled people - being mistreated, and ensure there is evidence of any mistreatment, so that action can be taken against offenders.

Cancel the energy bill rebate for second homes, I feel it is a very poor use of public money, when there are many more people urgently in need of support. The Government should amend this scheme so people are only eligible for a rebate for their main home.
Fund free Parking and NHS Hospitals For Staff and Patients, Free Parking For NHS Staff And Patients

Review quality of hospital care for disabled people, I believe many hospitals do not provide an adequate standard of care for disabled people, especially those with hidden disabilities or neurodevelopmental disorders.

Extend 30 hours free childcare to people with no access to public funds, 30 hours free childcare for 3-4 year olds is available for many UK residents but not those with no access to public funds. This should be extended to this class of residents to help them provide proper care to their children.

Start free childcare from child's 3rd birthday not the term after, Change the free 15/30 hours childcare offer so it starts at a child's 3rd birthday, and not the term after. Many families miss out on much needed months of support. Parents can miss out on up to five month's free childcare due to their child's birth date. This is unfair.

Provide ring-fenced funding for social housing designed for disabled people, I want the Government to increase availability of social housing specifically designed for disabled people by providing ring-fenced funding for this type of accommodation. The amount of ring-fenced funding should depend on the identified needs of disabled people in local authority areas.

Consider context and human behaviour in Section 3 of the Dangerous Dogs Act, Allow context and behaviour of all humans and animals involved in an incident to be part of the allegation process. Also consider qualifications and experience of all involved parties

Stronger sentences for online abuse, and fund mental health support, The Government should increase sentences for online abuse, including gaslighting and catfishing. They should also fund more mental health support for victims, and for those who work with vulnerable people including the police, social workers, charity workers, and emergency services.

Seek working holiday visa for young Britons to live and work in EEA countries, For the Government to seek to agree a deal with all EEA member states for young Britons to be able to access a working holiday visa. Agreements are already in place for Canada, Australia, New Zealand etc. However, since Brexit opportunities, to work and live in the EEA are limited.

Increase free childcare for working parents with children under school age, To make childcare more affordable for working parents with children under school age. 15 hours free childcare should be made accessible to all working parents for a child aged between 39 weeks to 3 years, before a working parent is eligible to claim for 30 hours free childcare once a child turns 3

Extend 15 hours free childcare to all 2-year old children, Cost of living crisis is real, and the measures put in place only just scratch the surface. Too many families are unable to have both parents work as childcare is so costly. If free childcare was available from 2 more could go to work and in turn more would pay tax to cover the extra funding needed.

Exclude US States that restrict abortion rights from any new US-UK trade deal, Government must review any US-UK free trade deal in light of the SCOTUS decision on Roe vs. Wade, and decisions by many states to restrict rights to abortion. The Government must exclude any US state that restricts a woman's right to abortion from any future trade deal.

Abolish reward trips based on attendance and behaviour, I want the government to make school trips accessible for all students regardless of behaviour and attendance I want all trips to be inclusive for all children/students
Provide free parking for all NHS staff on site, Provide free parking for all NHS staff at their place of work

Free childcare for working parents who have kids 2 years old, Families with kids under 3 years old struggling to pay for childcare and government encouraging people to stay at home on benefits so they can have free childcare and lots of money

Remove parking charges in Epping Forest, We would like to regain free, unhindered access to Epping Forest all over Essex and Greater London. We ask for removal of parking fees, red lines, barriers. Thank you, Waltham Forest Community

Fund improved facilities for ostomates in disabled toilets, The Government should fund local authorities and businesses to improve disabled toilets for the public and workers, so they meet the needs of people with a stoma (ostomates). Disabled toilets often do not have space required for the equipment needed to change a stoma bag.

Replace and up grade the water main supply to the Isle of Sheppey in Kent, insist that Southern water replace and upgrade the water main supply to the Isle of Sheppey in Kent due to the poor state of the existing pipe

Provide legal recognition for assistance animals other than dogs, All assistance animals (trained to aid or assist an individual with a disability) should be recognised in law, without limiting this to just dogs.

Fund extra provision of 1-to-1 childcare for SEND children under the age of 2, If a child has complex needs and requires 1-to-1 support there is no funding for this prior to a child's 2nd birthday. There is a huge gap between maternity and a child's 2nd birthday. Funding is needed to provide 1-to-1 childcare for SEND children under the age of 2, where this is required.

Require rainwater recovery for new builds and offer grants for older properties, The Government should require that all new builds have underground rainwater recovery systems installed. A grant scheme should also be set up. This could be funded by additional taxes on underperforming water companies, to help homeowners to retrofit on existing properties.

Require training on Autism for everyone who is in a childcare profession, Provide childcare settings the funding to be able to make sure all their staff are trained in understanding autism and what the signs are so that they are recognised earlier in a child's life and they are given the support both them and their families need. Make it a requirement by law that happens

Debate in Parliament loss of GMP indexation paid by DWP., I want the law changed so that people who reached state pension age on and after 6 April 2016 have the indexation paid on their guaranteed minimum pension (GMP)which is part of their occupational pension paid by the DWP.

Require local authorities provide interim accommodation to all homeless people, We want the Government to amend the Housing Act 1996 - by amending section 188 to remove the references to 'priority need', and repealing section 189 - so that local authorities must offer immediate accommodation to anyone without a home, and not just those identified as having a ‘priority need'.
Parent and Child parking space proof, Provide people with badges to prove that they can park in parent and child spaces, the same as disability spaces.

Allow deaths to be registered remotely, We want the Government to allow deaths to be registered in line with the temporary provisions of the Coronavirus Act 2020, which allowed deaths to be registered remotely, medical practitioners to sign death certificates without having attended the deceased, and documents be submitted electronically

Make public venues provide adequate seating in general areas, Make public venues provide adequate seating in general areas for those who are disabled or have mobility issues but to not require a wheelchair. Taking into example the O2 at Greenwich. This venue has no seating provided for those who have mobility issues between the car parking area and entrance.

Mandatory for all music festivals to offer free anonymous drug testing, Drugs will always get into music festivals and every year people die or their lives are changed for ever. It's time for this to stop. Let's make it mandatory for music festivals to offer free anonymous drug testing to help festival goers make informed choices.

Allow international students to work 30 hours a week in term time in Healthcare, Hundreds of thousands of international students come to the UK every year. If even a small minority took up work in the healthcare sector this could help tackle staffing shortages, and provide additional income tax revenue.

Make parking on someone else's driveway an offence, Currently the law does not protect property owners from other people parking on their private land. As the matter is civil it can take an eternity to pursue and at great cost to the landowner. Police should be given the power to remove offending vehicles at cost to the owner.

Introduce paid miscarriage leave for parents who experience pregnancy loss., Allow parents who lose a pregnancy before 24 weeks least three days to grieve by introducing paid miscarriage leave. 

1 in 4 pregnancies end in miscarriage. Under current legislation, workers are entitled to two weeks of paid bereavement leave following a stillbirth after 24 weeks of pregnancy.

Increase regulation of horse & pony non-profit/charity/rescue and riding schools, We want the government to increase regulations to protect horses and ponies from abuse, poor housing and care. The licensing framework for livery yards should be amended so that stables must be checked annually by local authorities. This could include spot checks and visits from vets.

Condemn Iran for human rights violations linked to the regime, We are urging the UK Government to condemn Iran in the strongest possible terms for recent and ongoing human rights violations linked to the regime, including the response to recent protests.

Update drunk and disorderly offence to include intoxication by drugs, We want the Government to expand the offence of being drunk and disorderly to include disorderly conduct after having used recreational drugs, and not just while being drunk.
Block all planning submitted to change use or build where DSA Airport is, Any submissions to change the use of the land where Doncaster Sheffield Airport is or build.

Review parking charges, restrictions, Lower parking charges.Pay for parking to operate on all bay types 08:00 - 18:00 plus permit/residence parking for local residence
Fairer parking fines.Disabled badge rules to be the same across borough. Cheaper congestion charge.
Discount entitlement or special permits for traidsmen,couriers ect

Prevent the introduction of any "programmable" CBDC in the UK, We are not completely adverse to a UK Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) scheme, however, we don't believe a CBDC should be “programmable”. This would mean that the issuer of the digital currency would have control over how an individual is permitted to use that currency.

Extend 30-hour free childcare funding to children from their first birthday., Give all children access to 30 hour free childcare funding from their first birthday with working parents resident in England, automatic access to 30 hours free funding per week during term time or 22 hours per week all year round at the hourly rate.

Fund 30 hours free childcare from age 1 for families where both parents work, There is often no benefit for both parents to work when childcare costs so much. My wife is working 20 hours a week on just over minimum wage which just covers childcare. Extending free childcare where both parents work would mean working families could better benefit from their employment.

Reduce the voting age to 12, As some people may have noticed, younger people have become involved in national and/or international politics, it is absolutely necessary that those who shape our future decide the future.

Seek stronger international sanctions against Iran, We want the Government to work with international partners in the UN to increase sanctions against Iran, to show support to women protesting against undemocratic, autocratic, repressive regimes.

Repeal the current Dangerous Dogs Act and replace with new framework, We want the Government to repeal the Dangerous Dogs Act and replace it with legislation that focuses on early intervention to prevent dog bites and tackle dog-related issues regardless of breed or type, based solely on their behaviour.

Increase tax-free childcare allowance in line with inflation, The tax-free childcare scheme was set up in 2017 to help support working parents with the cost of childcare. Over the past 5 years, the cost of childcare around England has increased on average by 22%. This allowance should raise by at least £440PA, to ensure it continues being supportive to parents

Amend Housing Act 1988 so leaseholders cannot be treated as ASTs, Leasehold properties could become unsaleable because under the Housing Act 1988 the freeholder could seek to evict the leaseholder as an Assured Shorthold Tenant for non-payment of ground rent, where this is more than £250 a year.
Amend the list of needs in the Animal Welfare Act 2006 Section 9(2), We want the Government to amend Section 9(2) of the Animal Welfare Act to replace the current list of needs with:
Create a Hearing Loss and Tinnitus Action Plan, We want the Government to create an action plan to raise awareness of hearing loss and tinnitus and improve support and prevention.
Save sunderland international airshow fom being cancelled, Talk with Sunderland city council to see if they can come to some sort of resolution
Keep triple lock on pensions, That the Government stick to what they said last year after freezing it that the Triple lock would be put back in place to be paid out in April 2023.

Require written parking fee reminder before fine, if no onsite payment available, ANPR systems are often used to issue parking fines for non-payment of parking fees. Charging for parking with no onsite payment provision relies on people noticing, reading and understanding signage, which is normally only in English, having internet access and remembering to pay.

New offence of stealing from a charity with a minimum 4-month sentence, I would like there to be a new, specific offence for anyone found guilty of stealing from a charity, including charity shops, with a mandatory custodial sentence of 4 months. In my opinion the Government is not doing enough and needs to crack down on stealing from charities.

Provide Financial Assistance to Non-Profit Animal Rescue Charities, I would like the UK Government to provide financial assistance to Non-Profit Animal Rescue Charities. Currently most charities rely on grants and donations, which they have to apply for and can be difficult to get because so many charities chase these small grants.

Make GHB and GBL Class 'A' drugs, We want GHB and GBL to be reclassified as Class A drugs, for a number of reasons: these drugs are associated with more deaths than ecstasy, GHB & GBL have been used in horrific crimes such as sexual assessment, rape and burglary, and these drug are addictive.

Restrict 'dangerously out of control' dog offence to cases of serious injury, Currently a dog is regarded as dangerously out of control if there is "reasonable apprehension that it will injure any person or assistance dog, whether or not it actually does so". We want this to be amended so that a dog is only regarded as dangerously out of control if serious injury occurs.

Decriminalise possession for personal use of all drugs, We believe current drugs policy is ineffective, and that the UK Government should following Portugal's approach and decriminalise the personal possession of all drugs. The Government should focus on support for addicts, not criminalisation.
Allow school Children in England to watch the England vs Iran game, I am petitioning to allow all students at schools in England to watch the match instead of having lessons.

Provide accessible information on cost of living support to disabled people, Ensure that clear and accessible information about cost of living support available to disabled people is provided to them at the earliest opportunity. This should include different formats which meet the needs of the end user, along with advice on how support will provided, or needs to be claimed.
Fully fund all home care for disabled people, We want the Government to increase funding for home care for disabled people so this is free for everyone who needs it.

Parking permits for drivers with a child in the car, Create a parking permit scheme, like the Blue Badge for disabled people, for people with children under 12 in the car. This should create the same or similar rights and restrictions as Blue Badges, including it being an offence to park in designated space without displaying a permit.

Ban unfair ground rent clauses from leasehold agreements, Developers selling new properties can no longer have unfair ground rent clauses in leases (eg where the ground rent can double every 10 years). This needs to be expanded so all leasehold properties built after 2000 cannot have such unfair ground rent clauses.

Make railcards accessible to all to reduce the cost of public transport., Currently railcard access ends at the age of 30 until the age of 60, unless specific circumstances. These ages are completely arbitrary and all should be granted access to a railcard if they see the benefit. This makes public transport cheaper which reduces road traffic and carbon emissions.

Amend the 1917 Titles Deprivation Act to remove honours, Amend the above Act so the government can, after consideration, remove honorary titles to disgraced persons who behave in a damaging way to the British government and the Royal family.

Build another road off Canvey Island &
stop authorising new builds., Pay for another road to be built.
Stop authorising new builds and retail parks.

Send a clear message to Talibans to allow Afghan girls to get educated., Hold Talibans accountable for the Hostage behaviour and let them know that the world 🌎 will not close their eyes on Afghanistan 🇦🇫. Girls have the right to get educated. Education is the way forward to brighter future.
